about.text: A powder of malted barley, wheat flour and dried whole milk, stirred into hot or cold milk or water. It began as an infant food and became a drink and a flavour of sweets.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

facts.v: Roller, spray or vacuum drying all occur (Indian standard IS 1806:2018, seen in a search summary)
Syrup beaten about 15–20 min into a taffy, rolled into sheets about 3/16 in thick, cut to balls, puffed and dried under about 28 in vacuum; figures partly garbled in the scanned text
Sold as a drink (unsaccharified type) or as a bread-making enzyme ingredient (saccharified type)
Grains and malt soaked in milk, heated, enzymatically reacted, pressed and vacuum-dried into granules
